question: Avoprokenya avocado oil company owner manufacturer
markdown:
Avopro EPZ Limited
(operating as
⁠Avoprokenya
) is a Kenyan manufacturing company located in Sagana, Kirinyaga County, Kenya. It processes extra virgin and crude cold-pressed avocado oil working with a network of nearly 5,000 smallholder farmers. It is registered as a private Export Processing Zone (EPZ) enterprise.
